findings.finding: Norcros, the UK's largest branded bathroom-products group and Roper Rhodes' closest listed peer, said on 15 October that UK demand softened in its Q2 (July to early October), the same months as Svedbergs' Q3, and that conditions will stay subdued through H2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: UK logistics-driven margin pressure was part of the Q2 2026 EBITA miss (EPS 0.78 vs ~1.10 est.), which fell 8.95% on the day
findings.why_not_priced: Both broker previews (ABG 2 Oct, SB1 28 Sep) predate it, and ABG explicitly kept UK organic growth unchanged. The stock rose from 55.5 to 57.4 in the four sessions after it, so it has not traded on it. If it were priced, the 5-day run-up would be flat or negative, not +4.1%. Held small because it is a peer read-across, Svedbergs already called UK demand subdued in July, and the UK is roughly a quarter to a third of group sales.
findings.independence: Topps Tiles' 1 Oct FY trading update: flat UK like-for-likes, Q4 hit by heat (https://www.hl.co.uk/shares/stock-market-news/company--news/topps-tiles-reiterates-outlook-despite-softer-sales)

findings.finding: The Dalstorp efficiency programme announced on 15 September (headcount cuts, about 25 MSEK a year in savings) gave no cost figure. A restructuring provision will probably land in Q3 and hold headline EBIT and EPS below the adjusted bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The announcement day itself moved -0.18% (2026-09-15 close 56.6), so the market shrugged off the programme
findings.original_quote: "Åtgärderna bedöms förbättra rörelseresultatet succesivt med ca 25 MSEK på årsbasis, med full effekt från och med det andra kvartalet 2027. Omorganisationen innebär en minskning av antalet tjänster. Förhandlingar med berörda fackliga parter inleds..." (The measures are expected to improve operating profit gradually by about SEK 25m a year, with full effect from Q2 2027. The reorganisation means fewer positions. Negotiations with the unions are starting...)
findings.why_not_priced: The cost has never been disclosed, and yahoo-style EPS consensus (Q3 2025 est 0.88) is not adjusted for it. SB1 already names restructuring costs as a Q3 drag, so most professional holders expect it. A one-off with a savings path attached is usually looked through, which is why this is small.
findings.independence: SB1 preview explicitly expects restructuring costs to weigh on Q3 (https://www.placera.se/telegram/svedbergs-group-sb1-upprepar-kop-for-svedbergs-och-riktkurs-75-kronor-20260928)

findings.finding: The two dated broker previews disagree by 10% on Q3 adjusted EBITA (SB1 80 MSEK at -1% organic, ABG 88 MSEK at +2% organic). SB1 says consensus 'does not yet reflect the full earnings effect', which puts the risk of a headline miss against the higher numbers.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 EBITA came in below expectations and the stock fell 8.95%. Q1 2026 (15.9% margin) rose 4.57% and gave it back the next day.
findings.original_quote: "Inför tredje kvartalet räknar analyshuset med en organisk tillväxt på -1 procent och justerad ebita på 80 miljoner kronor... konsensus ännu inte speglar hela resultateffekten" (Ahead of Q3 the broker expects organic growth of -1% and adjusted EBITA of SEK 80m... consensus does not yet reflect the full earnings effect)
findings.why_not_priced: Both are public previews, so this is mostly in the wire copy. What is not settled is which end of the range the market holds, because no aggregated Q3 consensus was findable. My own build from company documents (~83) sits between the two, so this is a small lean, not a call.

findings.finding: Byggmaterialindex showed Swedish building-materials sales up 9.5% in Q2 2026 (volume +6.5%, B2C +10.3%), and dealers' outlook for the next quarter rose to 3.9 on a 1-5 scale. That cuts against the -4% Nordic organic decline ABG models for Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Nordic organic swings drove the strong Q4 2025 (+10% organic, +9.85% on the day)
findings.original_quote: "Mätt på jämförbara enheter ökade omsättningen under det andra kvartalet med 9,5 procent jämfört med samma period föregående år. Den uppskattade volymutvecklingen uppgår till 6,5 procent... Under Q1 uppgick indexvärdet till 3,8 och har nu stigit till 3,9." (Like-for-like sales rose 9.5% y/y in Q2; estimated volume +6.5%... the forward index rose from 3.8 to 3.9)
findings.why_not_priced: It is a Swedish-language trade-body release that no English preview cites. But Svedbergs' own Q2 report said Sweden was slightly weaker y/y while this index was +9.5%, so the company's number contradicts the proxy, and Q3 2025 carried the expanded-ROT boost. Sized close to zero.

findings.finding: UBC's disclosed run-rate (365 MSEK RTM sales, ~12% EBITA margin) works out to ~91 MSEK a quarter against ABG's 81 MSEK Q3 contribution. That is a small upside cushion of about 1 MSEK EBITA, if Czech seasonality does not absorb it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior full quarter of UBC. Q2 carried only about 3 weeks of it (+4.1% sales contribution).
findings.original_quote: "För den rullande tolvmånadersperioden som avslutades den 31 december 2025 uppgick UBCs nettoomsättning till 34 miljoner EUR (cirka 365 miljoner SEK) samt EBITA till 4,2 miljoner EUR (cirka 45 miljoner SEK), vilket motsvarar en EBITA marginal om cirka 12 procent." (For the twelve months to 31 Dec 2025 UBC's sales were EUR 34m (~SEK 365m) and EBITA EUR 4.2m (~SEK 45m), about a 12% margin)
findings.why_not_priced: Brokers have modelled it, so the gap is just 10 MSEK of sales between a run-rate and ABG's seasonally lower figure. Near zero.
findings.independence: EURCZK Q3 average ~1% lower y/y, a small translation help (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/EURCZK=X?range=2y&interval=1d)

findings.finding: The currency drag that cost Q2 sales about 2.1pp fades in Q3: GBPSEK averaged +1.2% y/y and EURSEK -0.1% y/y over Jul-Sep 2026 against Jul-Sep 2025, so translation is roughly neutral to slightly positive.
findings.why_not_priced: Brokers model FX, so this is mostly in. It only matters against anyone extrapolating Q2's -2.1pp. Worth well under 1 MSEK of EBITA.

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly negative while the 5-day run-up is +4.1% (a bounce from 53.0 to 57.4) and the priced lean is about zero (-0.14, all run-up), so they cut slightly against the recent tape; with no anchor on positioning and a disputed bar, p_up sits only five points off 50.
language_note: The SB1 Markets preview (adj. EBITA 80 MSEK, organic -1%, 'konsensus ännu inte speglar hela resultateffekten') was found only as a Swedish Placera telegram. The English sources carried only ABG's higher 88 MSEK, so the bar dispute is visible only through the Swedish source.
The Byggmaterialindex Q2 2026 Swedish trade-body series (+9.5% sales, forward index 3.9) exists only in Swedish.
Issuer releases (Q2 report, efficiency programme, UBC deal) are bilingual on MFN and the Swedish versions added nothing over the English ones, as the Nordic premise warns.
lessons_applied: 'Guidance reiterated or none: median 2.3%' against 'numbers new: 7.4%': Svedbergs gives no guidance, so abs_move_pct went from 6.5 to 6.0, still well above the 3.8 baseline proxy because 'understatement is the systematic error' and its real print-day moves are 4-10%.
'A beat made of a one-off is sold' / one-off at a fraction of the money: the restructuring-charge finding went from -0.3 to -0.2.
'A narrow proxy loses... company-level number beats an industry proxy': Byggmaterialindex went from +0.3 to +0.1, because Svedbergs' own Q2 said Sweden was weaker while the index was +9.5%.
'Net of the rest of the company': the Norcros UK read-across went from -0.6 to -0.5, since the UK is roughly a quarter to a third of sales and the company already called UK demand subdued.
Bar disputed (two sources 10% apart), so findings stay capped small: the SB1 'consensus too high' finding went from -0.4 to -0.3 because it is wire copy.
